title: Test first: Health diagnostics as a real table
goal: A failing test describes the table: columns Status, Sent, Received, Latency, In flight, Reconnects, Memory; rows Service sample and one per link
acceptance: test/dashboard-live-views.test.mjs: a <table> with caption, <th scope=col> and <th scope=row>, one row for the service sample (RSS, heap, loop delay, polls) and one per link; empty states keep a single readable row; the warning state is text as well as colour
Units in the header or cell (MB, ms, bytes shown as KB/MB when large), not-applicable cells show a dash with an accessible name
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 from the existing code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
